method.summary: Candidates from Wikivoyage Sleep sections, digital-nomad guides (Memoirs of Acacia, A Way Abroad, Tiny Living), web search and Hostelworld; each record verified on an official site or listing opened on 2026-09-26. Features/prices only where stated on a cited page. Coordinates from OSM (Overpass extract or Nominatim, 1 req/s with a descriptive User-Agent).
method.nearby_work: Nearest 3 coworking spaces/cafés from nomad-cities.json by great-circle (haversine) distance. Work places without coordinates in nomad-cities.json were geocoded with Nominatim where a named or street match existed; each entry's work_point_geo states the precision. Distances are straight-line, not walking.
method.geo_precision: building = OSM object for the property; street = street centroid; area = neighbourhood/locality point (approximate); null = not geocoded.

best_areas_to_live.name: Thamel
best_areas_to_live.description: Kathmandu's backpacker district: 'a maze of alleys crammed with handicraft shops, guest houses, and cafés' whose core is traffic-free (Wikivoyage). Wikivoyage notes virtually all tourist accommodation is in Thamel; Nomadista calls it loud and busy but central.

best_areas_to_live.name: Jhamsikhel / Sanepa (Lalitpur)
best_areas_to_live.description: A street in Jhamsikhel 'popular with expatriates and locals' is informally known as 'Jhamel' — 'much more chilled out' than Thamel (Wikivoyage Patan). Tiny Living calls Sanepa/Jhamsikhel/Pulchowk 'the single best remote-work cafe density in Kathmandu Valley'.

center.geo_source: Midpoint of Nominatim neighbourhood nodes Jhamsikhel (node/2313807795) and Sanepa (node/2313807942)

best_areas_to_live.name: Patan Durbar area (Lalitpur)
best_areas_to_live.description: Patan, about 4 km from Thamel, is 'fast becoming an area of preference for those in the know looking for more space and less chaos'; many expatriate communities live there because INGOs and some embassies are located in Patan (Wikivoyage). Patan Durbar Square is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

center.geo_source: Nominatim: Patan Durbar Square neighbourhood node (node/2230569085)

best_areas_to_live.name: Boudha (Boudhanath)
best_areas_to_live.description: East Kathmandu area around one of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world, surrounded by at least 29 Tibetan gompas; a UNESCO site since 1979 (Wikivoyage). Wikivoyage notes 'some good deals' on accommodation around Boudha; Nomadista describes a calm, international, spiritual vibe.

best_areas_to_live.name: Lazimpat
best_areas_to_live.description: Central Kathmandu's embassy and hotel strip: CIWEC travel clinic is 'Located centrally in Lazimpat, across from the British embassy' (Wikivoyage). Nabin Gaire recommends the Himalayan Java branch in Lazimpat's Bluebird Mall for focused work.

best_areas_to_live.name: Baluwatar
best_areas_to_live.description: Residential area that a rem.work listing describes as 'a peaceful residential area' surrounded by 'the Prime Ministers Quarter, Nepal Rashtriya Bank, the President’s resident and over 20 tea houses, cafes and restaurants'. Café Soma has a Baluwatar branch tagged with Wi-Fi on OSM.

best_areas_to_live.name: Lakeside
best_areas_to_live.description: Where most visitors stay, along Phewa (Fewa) Lake; Wikivoyage says the lakeside strip 'now feels more like Khao San Road' and is the best place for live music. A Way Abroad (2024) suggests any place within a 20-minute walk of Phewa Lake is a good base.

best_areas_to_live.name: Baidam (Lakeside East)
best_areas_to_live.description: OSM places most of the Lakeside strip in Baidam (Pokhara ward 6); Wikivoyage calls the southern end off Baidam Road 'Lakeside East'. Long-stay apartment operators here describe their side streets as quieter and 'tucked away from the busier streets' while still a short walk to Phewa Lake (Holiday Home Apartment, Montana Inn).

best_areas_to_live.name: Khahare (North Lakeside)
best_areas_to_live.description: The north end of Lakeside around Khahare Chowk and Bangladi. Wikivoyage describes Khahare as 'north of lakeside' where slight elevation gives 'the most spectacular views to the lake'; Forest Lake Backpackers' Hostel describes Bangladi, 'at the north end of Lakeside', as having views of Fewa Lake.

best_areas_to_live.name: Sarangkot
best_areas_to_live.description: Hill above the lake, known for sunrise views of the Annapurna range. Wikivoyage: around 12 guesthouses uphill 'offer better views and less air pollution, but are much more expensive'; they are a 20-minute walk uphill on gravel from the Sarangkot taxi stand.

best_areas_to_live.name: Damside
best_areas_to_live.description: Tourist area by Phewa Lake (Wikivoyage lists hotels and restaurants on Damside Marg/Damside Rd); Wikivoyage: 'Virtually all tourist accommodations are in Lakeside and Damside, near Phewa Lake.'

stays.why_nomads: A coliving retreat built for digital nomads with private rooms, desks, fibre Wi-Fi and a coworking area, sold in 30-day cohorts.
